title: Estimated embedded-document growth
method: Synthetic size model:2 KiB fixed parent plus 0.5 KiB per child. Totals for 10,100 and 1,000 children are 7,52 and 502 KiB. Real BSON encoding and update cost must be measured; these estimates are not size-limit recommendations.
alt: Estimated embedded-document growth. 10 children: 7 KiB; 100 children: 52 KiB; 1,000 children: 502 KiB. Illustrative values.
